nonlinear_resolution_floor.note: flow_path = 9 * mean flow_speed is EXACT in the extractor (phase1_controls C3, rel_resid 2.4e-4).  Whatever this scan reports for that pair is the binning resolution floor: nothing below it is resolvable.

F5_spectrum.note: 384 bank columns; the observed matrix is degenerate because of the definitional duplicates catalogued in phase1_definitional.py, so this is a description of the cache, not a finding.

unfitted_denoising_drift.definition: std(x[step9] - x[step0]) / std(x); no coefficient is fitted, so this is the conserved-quantity form of the top frozen relation
